name: Explicit Intersection Alpha Compositing
definition: Alpha compositing of 2D Gaussians using explicit intersection pairs (gaussian_id, pixel_id, image_id), allowing arbitrary intersection patterns and relying on automatic differentiation for the backward pass.
summary: Explicit Intersection Alpha Compositing is the final 2D Gaussian Splatting step that efficiently aggregates pre-computed alpha values onto the image plane using explicit intersection pairs, differing from Gamma-Space Alpha Blending by operating in linear RGB space.
